title: nerfWatch(): did they nerf it?
excerpt: Daily tests and community votes on whether AI models got nerfed. Each model is only ever compared with its own first week.
content_html:
Last test Sep 26 · next test Sep 27

Did they nerf it? We test. You vote.

Every model takes the same test every day and is only ever compared with its own first week. Then it's your turn: say how it feels, and see if the numbers back you up.
